answer: Probe each identity with odd, randomized prompts whose replies fingerprint the model and instructions behind it. Ask every agent to finish a nonsense story about a grove that grows at the nadir of a dry canyon; independent agents run different models and setups, so their quirks scatter. Three hundred clones driven by one configuration return near-identical oddities, word choices and refusals. Matching fingerprints are paid as one seat, and disguising each clone means running genuinely distinct setups.
